milestone: One owner-loop + spawned P0 inference worker + explicit CPU FIFO acknowledgments, preserving actual model input and current submit clocks

fixed_inputs.fit_episode: Previously seen M1 offline capture, not heldout
fixed_inputs.checkpoint_parameters: Frozen after prior200updates; no optimizer or newweightfile
fixed_inputs.sampling: One 16-step DDIM invocation, one original sample, CPU only, fixed initial noise seed20261016
fixed_inputs.model_input_payload: Only image/proprio/nominaloffsets/mask; excludes future actions/labels/audit scores; exact complete tensor bundle delivered as public packet

clock_and_schedule.owner_state_clock: Explicit CPU synthetic tick with fixture time mapping, separate measured monotonic wall; no claimed realtime physics
clock_and_schedule.original_deadline: Pre-execution header fixed beyond tick120, never reanchored
clock_and_schedule.past_slots: Record STALE; do not move to future tick
clock_and_schedule.purpose: ORIGINAL_GOAL; no teacher or recovery label
clock_and_schedule.late_or_all_stale: Retain full outcome, no retry for improvement

acceptance: Worker receives exact bytes frozen at start and uses no target/audit data
Actual CPU model inference emits finite8x9 with checkpoint/parameter hashes unchanged
Owner loop observations occur while worker computation runs, measured overlap or explicitly report absent
Each original slot obtains one disposition and committed 9D command only enters CPU FIFO after durable intent
CPU acknowledgments preserve original actor,target,readytick,FIFO; nophysicalAPPLIEDclaim
Full journal independently replayed; invalid mutations leave accepted state unchanged
Owned worker terminates and no accidentalGPU/SDK/modelAPI invocation

threat_contract.trust_boundary: Model worker output is untrusted; mainowner supplies currentstate/clock; journalreplay rejects malformed sources
threat_contract.trusted_assumptions: OS and caller packet classification; no cryptographic sensor authentication, confidential process isolation, or hardware exactly-once claimed
denied_paths: incomplete persist success leading to send

open_dependencies: Independent bridge source and reader CPU gates
No native readiness until pinned SDK/channel and new separately budgeted short native case
Fullrobot load/unload/torque and SFR pools stillopen
